layers.def: The Engine wraps a licensed Swiss-Ephemeris-grade calculation vendor (Prokerala / AstrologyAPI class). Deterministic charts, transits, and timing — verified against reference ephemerides, never generated by a language model.
layers.sub: The market map's first recommendation, verbatim: do NOT build the ephemeris core.

layers.def: Corpus constrains every interpretive draft to named, versioned tradition corpora with citations. A draft that can't name its lineage doesn't ship. This is what separates practitioner-grade interpretation from the free horoscope slurry.
layers.sub: Hellenistic · Vedic · esoteric tarot · Pythagorean numerology, at launch.

layers.def: Voice models belong to the practitioner — trained only on their material, exportable on exit, deleted on our side after export. Memory belongs to the seeker — consented, viewable, revocable. We are custodians, not owners.
layers.sub: Ownership is a contract term, not a marketing word.

layers.def: Attest signs every reading on C2PA-style provenance rails: verified-human authorship or review, disclosed AI assistance, tamper-evidence. Seals verify independently of us — if DOGM.AI vanished tomorrow, every seal still checks.
layers.sub: Filling a real gap: C2PA has no free certificate path for individuals. We are that path for this vertical.

layers.def: Guardrails encode SB 243, NY §1700, and EU AI Act Article 5 as executable policy: hard refusals, disclosure by default, crisis protocols, and an exportable audit trail that doubles as payments-underwriting evidence.
layers.sub: One layer, two jobs: regulator-ready and processor-ready.
